component.name: ReGa
component.summary: Play games on a cloud machine you own

description.p: ReGa is an early preview of an app that sets up a Windows gaming machine in your own cloud account and streams it to your desktop with Moonlight. This version suggests an AWS region by latency and price, and launches, resizes, stops and destroys machines; setting up the stream comes in a later release.
It reads your AWS credentials from ~/.aws. Without them it shows sample data.
